friction_events.description: Five compatible claim CREATEs returned CREATE_EXISTS; worker advanced without overwriting ownership.
One claim path repeatedly lost non-forced main-head CAS during unrelated concurrent commits; no force push occurred and the worker switched candidate after bounded attempts.
Primary Chat approval wiring exposed one legacy regression assumption, then a concurrent-main push race; tests were updated and the workflow was made fresh-main/idempotent before the passing run.
Several append-only receipt CREATEs hit concurrent main movement and succeeded on bounded retry after confirming the target path remained absent.

Two Guide Integrators described the same private-ingress correlation residual with different pre-hash semantic identities. Stable job-path CREATE prevented duplicate materialization and a bounded canonicalization repair was opened.
Repeated José V11 source recovery had no new causal input after G3/G6; ordinary recovery was fixed at G6 until new authoritative source evidence appears.

Useful Reserve live latency remained unmeasurable because fresh CURRENT evidence had zero verified reserve candidates and no simultaneous real human-intent transition; recovery was bounded instead of synthesizing filler.

exit_audit_v1.public_safe_summary: Fresh PROD-01 worker completed 6/6 productive units: scale-readiness evidence, Primary Chat approval replay/UI source wiring with passing CI, two Guide integrations, one repeated-source-recovery stop, and one Useful Reserve live-precondition stop. It created no parallel scheduler or authority, did not retry an inherited safety-denied STT path, did not claim browser/private served E2E, and closed only after the target was durably reached.
